functionalRequirement: System shall provide an interface for Application Administrators to reset user passwords.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The password reset interface must support all required administrative functions including search for users, verification of user identity, and password reset confirmation for 100% of user accounts in the system.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires a complete interface for administrators to perform password resets, necessitating full coverage of all related functions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The password reset interface must enforce role-based access control ensuring only authenticated administrators with proper authorization can access the functionality.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive password management operations that must be restricted to authorized administrators only.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All password reset activities must be logged with administrator ID, timestamp, affected user, and action taken, with logs retained for a minimum of 90 days.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Password resets are security-sensitive operations requiring accountability and audit capabilities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must enforce generation of temporary passwords that comply with organizational password complexity requirements (minimum 12 characters, including uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves password management which requires security controls to maintain system integrity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The password reset interface must allow administrators to complete a standard password reset operation in less than 30 seconds with no more than 5 steps.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR specifies an interface for administrators who need efficient operations for routine tasks.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The password reset interface must provide clear confirmation messages for successful operations and descriptive error messages for failed operations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Administrative interfaces require clear feedback to ensure administrators understand the outcome of their actions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The password reset functionality must be available 99.9% of the time during business hours (8:00 AM to 6:00 PM local time, Monday through Friday).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Password resets are critical administrative functions that must be highly available when administrators need to perform them.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The password reset interface must be implemented as a separate module that can be updated independently from other system components.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Security-related interfaces benefit from modular design to facilitate updates and security patches.

functionalRequirement: System shall be able to perform distance calculations and access geo-location information for the user, sites, and nearby sites.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must accurately calculate distances between user, sites, and nearby sites using all required geo-location data types (e.g., latitude, longitude) for 100% of specified use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to perform distance calculations and access geo-location information, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must calculate distances between user, sites, and nearby sites in less than 100 milliseconds for up to 1,000 concurrent requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time access to geo-location data and calculations, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must use no more than 50 MB of memory to process geo-location data and distance calculations for a single request.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR's focus on handling multiple sites and users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The geo-location services must be available 99.95% of the time, with a maximum downtime of 5 minutes per day.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to geo-location services, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User geo-location data must be encrypted using TLS 1.3 during transmission and AES-256 when stored.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves accessing user location, which is sensitive data requiring protection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must obtain explicit user consent before accessing geo-location information and provide options to revoke this consent.
identifiedNFRs.justification: User location data is sensitive personal information requiring privacy controls and user agency.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must display distance information in both metric (kilometers) and imperial (miles) units, with user preference settings.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Distance calculations should be presented in formats that are recognizable and appropriate for different user preferences.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support multiple geo-location providers (minimum of 3) with the ability to switch between them without system downtime.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR depends on geo-location services which may require adaptability to different providers.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must be able to identify and display a minimum of 50 nearby sites within a 10km radius in under 2 seconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR mentions nearby sites, implying the need for efficient processing of multiple location points.
